definitions.gloss: report-contact-consult, communication basics in the workplace
definitions.explanation: An abbreviation of {報告|ほうこく} (report), {連絡|れんらく} (contact/inform), and {相談|そうだん} (consult). A fundamental workplace communication principle in Japan emphasizing that employees should proactively report progress, share relevant information, and consult superiors when problems arise.

examples.japanese: {報連相|ほうれんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget to report, contact, and consult.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{報連相|ほうれんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I learned the importance of report-contact-consult during new employee training.

examples.japanese: {報連相|ほうれんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きて→起きる：00521_okiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{素早|すばや}く→素早い：17093_subayai⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A team that practices good report-contact-consult can respond quickly even when problems arise.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
A portmanteau of ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (report), ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ (contact/inform), and ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (consult). The abbreviation deliberately sounds like ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach), making it a memorable mnemonic.

USAGE:
One of the most widely taught workplace communication concepts in Japan, introduced to nearly all new employees. It is considered a foundational skill for smooth teamwork and is frequently referenced in business books and training materials. Failure to practice {報連相|ほうれんそう} is a common criticism of junior employees.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {報連相|ほうれんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: thoroughly practice report-contact-consult
- {報連相|ほうれんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧: report-contact-consult is important
- {報連相|ほうれんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧: unable to properly report/contact/consult
